method: Universe: Nifty 500, complete daily candles only. Risk filters: at least 200 trading days of history; price above the 200-day average; 50-day average above the 200-day average; worst fall in 12 months smaller than 35%; volatility under 45% a year; rsi between 45 and 72; average daily traded value at least ₹2 crore. Technical score (0–50): 6-month strength vs Nifty 20, trend strength (ADX) 10, low volatility 10, small drawdown 10. Fundamental score (0–50, Upstox only): ROCE, ROE, 3-year sales and profit growth, P/E vs scanned industry peers. Trade plan: entry zone from the close down to 1×ATR below it; stop at the lower of the 20-day swing low and 2×ATR below the close; target 2× the risk; ideas whose plan breaks a rule are not shown. Stops never move.
